Mendelian genetics is the study of the effects of mutations in the activities of enzymes on fluxing metabolic pathways, and that the effects of such mutations are not additive.
Mendel's laws are a consequence of the non-linear response of fluxing metabolic systems to mutations in their enzymes.

the origin of dominant traits is a consequence of the non-linearity of the flux response to graded changes in an enzyme's activity.
the Mendelian laws of inheritance are not laws of nature, they are laws of human logic, and they are not laws at all.
